verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow: logo panel, then eyebrow and headline, then body, then the CTA with 'Ships late June' grouped under it. Its flaws: the body copy is cramped and leaves an orphaned 'solstice.', the legal text is unreadably small and jammed under the body, the headline is set small for its length, and the divider floats loosely. B breaks in several places. The eyebrow is cut off from the headline and dropped into a strip under the logo panel, and 'Ships late June' wraps into a three-line column of single words. The undersized CTA is squeezed into the top-right corner above a block of legal text that competes with it, and the right side is crowded while the logo panel's dark block is left mostly empty.
